question: TTL vs CMOS: What Is the Difference?
body_html:
TTL vs CMOS compares logic built from bipolar transistors with logic built from complementary MOSFETs. CMOS draws almost no idle power, so it dominates modern designs.

ParameterTTL at 5 V74HC CMOS at 5 V
VIH minimum2.0 VAbout 3.5 V
VIL maximum0.8 VAbout 1.5 V
VOH minimum2.4 VAbout 4.9 V
Static powerAbout 10 mW per gateAbout 10 nW

A 2.4 V TTL high may not reach a 74HC input.
